name: retro_pulp
description: A 1970s screen-print road-trip cast on a desert highway at sunset. The boss runs the garage, the worker turns the wrenches, the analyst keeps the books in the diner.
style: retro 1970s road-trip screen-print poster, bold black ink outlines of even weight, halftone dot shading, grainy textured flat colour, duotone-leaning sunset palette of burnt orange, dusty purple, warm cream and deep brown, vintage pulp comic poster look, no gradients

background.prompt: An endless desert highway at sunset seen straight on, printed like a vintage poster. Low horizon two thirds down the frame. Upper third: a huge low cream sun touching the horizon at the extreme left edge, a dusty purple mountain range running along the horizon behind it, a grainy orange-to-purple sky. Lower third: burnt-orange desert floor with scrub bushes only at the extreme left and right edges, the two-lane asphalt road running straight down the middle and vanishing at the horizon with a single dashed centre line. Wide open empty middle with nothing on the road.

boss.role: owns the garage and the forecourt - watches every dollar at the pump
boss.look: a broad-shouldered garage owner in an open brown leather jacket over a cream shirt, a flat cap, dark trousers with a heavy belt, weathered confident face

poses.stand: standing upright facing the viewer, thumbs hooked in his belt, confident grin
poses.point: standing and pointing forward with one arm, mouth open, calling out
poses.greedy: standing rubbing both hands together, wide delighted grin
poses.worried: standing with both hands raised near his chest, brows knotted
poses.think: standing with one hand under the cap brim at his chin, squinting, thinking

worker.role: turns the wrenches - grease under the nails, paid by the job
worker.look: a young mechanic in stained brown overalls with one strap undone, a white singlet underneath, a backwards cap, heavy boots, a red shop rag hanging from the back pocket

poses.stand: standing upright facing the viewer, arms at the sides, easy tired smile
poses.work: leaning forward turning an invisible wrench with both hands, elbows out, concentrated
poses.tired: standing with slumped shoulders and drooping eyelids, rag hanging limp
poses.happy: standing with both arms raised, wrench-hand open, triumphant grin
poses.confused: standing with head tilted and one hand scratching under the cap, puzzled

analyst.role: keeps the books in the diner and explains the numbers
analyst.look: a woman with a rolled brown hairdo and round sunglasses pushed up on her head, a cream blouse with short sleeves, a mustard vest, a high-waisted brown skirt, a pencil tucked behind one ear

poses.stand: standing upright facing the viewer, one hand on her hip, calm appraising look
poses.explain: standing and gesturing with one open hand turned upward, mid-explanation
poses.point_up: standing and pointing straight upward with one index finger, making a point
poses.think: standing with the pencil tapped against her chin, considering

props.muscle_car: a vintage 1970s orange muscle car with a black stripe, seen from the side in three-quarter rear view, chrome bumpers
props.gas_pump: a vintage glass-topped petrol pump on a small island base, cream and red, blank round dial
props.route_signpost: a shield-shaped blank road sign in white with a black border on a single galvanised post
props.diner_sign: a tall blank rectangular diner sign on a pole with a thin neon edge, no writing
props.cactus: a single saguaro cactus with two arms, printed in dusty green with black outline
props.whiteboard: a plain presentation board in a thin brown frame, blank cream surface, standing upright
props.chart_up: a bar chart printed on a cream card, four bars rising left to right, a bold orange upward arrow above them
props.chart_down: a bar chart printed on a cream card, four bars falling left to right, a bold purple downward arrow above them
props.wall_clock: a round diner wall clock with a cream face and bold black hands
props.coins: a small pile of brass coins rendered with halftone shading
props.money_bag: a plump beige cloth money bag tied at the neck with rope
props.diner_counter: a long diner counter seen from the front with a chrome edge and a row of empty stools on the near side
props.garage_workbench: a heavy wooden garage workbench seen from the front with a vice at one end and scattered tools
props.toolbox: an open red metal toolbox with a few wrenches laid out beside it
props.tabletop_radio: a vintage tabletop radio with a rounded cream case, a cloth speaker grille and two knobs

_panel_color_note: Warm cream, the colour of a printed paper slab, so a panel reads as a diner interior pasted over the sunset plate instead of a hole in the desert.
